warnings.message: Antigravity can't reference an environment variable in an MCP config, so @examples/github-mcp's `Authorization` header was left out; add it in Antigravity's MCP settings.

Antigravity can't reference an environment variable in an MCP config, so @examples/github-mcp's `GITHUB_TOKEN` wasn't written; set it in the environment Antigravity starts in, which the server inherits.
Antigravity's agents can't name an MCP tool, so `mcp:github-mcp` was left out of @examples/code-reviewer's tools; the agent can still use the server's tools.
Antigravity's agents can't preload skills, so @examples/code-reviewer's skills are installed but not preloaded; the agent finds them as any other skill.
